# Billing Research Note 4

Prior research on comparable products shows billing handling of surcharge interacts with subscription; teams noted that ledger depends on refund and installment, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm billing handling of payout interacts with currency; teams noted that proration depends on dunning and invoiceline, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that billing handling of gateway interacts with writeoff; teams noted that receipt depends on tax and renewal, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that billing handling of invoice interacts with discount; teams noted that reconciliation depends on chargeback and arrears, especially under real production load.
